description: codefast lifecycle hooks for a Codex config layer: what `codefast setup --harness codex --hooks --scope project` writes. Merge the hooks object into ~/.codex/hooks.json or <repo>/.codex/hooks.json. Codex does not load hooks from a plugin that uses the Agent Plugins manifest, so they are registered here instead. They need codefast on PATH, only add context, and CODEFAST_HOOKS=off turns all of them off.
